selection_policy: Fixed economic pair watchlist; each pair becomes eligible after 252-session pair-price coverage.
research_role: Activity diagnostic only; it deliberately removes the daily cointegration/stability gate and is not a validated strategy.
signal_model: 60 prior daily closes; signal close evaluated out of sample; next-session open execution.
position_model: Alpha, beta, and residual scale are frozen at entry; legs are not rebalanced; exit z is measured against the entry model.
exit_rules: Exit on z-score crossing zero or +/-4 z hard stop (both against the frozen entry model).

kalman_filter.model: Two-state random walk on log-price intercept and hedge beta.
kalman_filter.signal_timing: One-step-ahead innovation at close t uses the state through t-1; current close updates state; posterior hedge is used at next-session open.
kalman_filter.initialization: OLS on first 60 aligned closes; measurement variance initialized from residual variance.
limitations: Fixed process-noise settings are exploratory and not tuned.
Kalman uses predictive-innovation scaling, so both hedge adaptation and z-score scale differ from OLS.

pnl_normalization: Each trade starts at one unit of gross pair notional. Summed trade P&L is un-compounded, not a portfolio return.
limitations: Results use the already-inspected 2006-2026 sample; they are not confirmatory holdout results.
Variant-grid selection on this history is exploratory; keep a final untouched holdout before trusting any chosen setting.
Daily adjusted OHLC execution is approximate; spread, borrow, financing, and market impact are omitted.
